mainEntity.name: What is a travel insurance plan for solo travel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you’re traveling solo or as part of a group, a travel insurance plan functions much the same. Travel insurance plans provide coverage for certain events or losses, such as trip cancellation, lost baggage recovery, medical assistance and more. Without a travel insurance plan, solo travelers are at risk for incurring additional fees for unexpected circumstances, which can be a burden when paying for a vacation by yourself. A travel insurance plan can help you enjoy your trip knowing your travel investment can be covered.

mainEntity.name: What does a travel insurance plan cover for solo travelers?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Travel Guard offers customizable travel insurance plans for your solo vacation. Look for a plan that has the coverage and benefit limits you need. Popular plan features include:

- Medical expense coverage 

- Trip cancellation/interruption coverage 

- Missed flight connection assistance 

- Baggage coverage 

- Car rental coverage (optional add-on coverage) 

- Cancel For Any Reason (optional add-on coverage available with certain plans) 

- Adventure Sports Bundle (optional add-on coverage available with certain plans) 

- Emergency travel assistance – specialized representatives are available 24/7 for emergency assistance, a big relief when traveling alone

mainEntity.name: Do I need a travel insurance plan for my solo trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a travel insurance plan is not a requirement for traveling alone, it can be an essential tool when it comes to protecting your travel investment. When you are a solo traveler, you bear the burden of your finances alone. Any unexpected expenses can take a toll on your bank account. Your travel insurance plan can help cover your travel investment. As a solo traveler, you should consider finding a travel insurance plan with 24/7 emergency assistance. You never know when a travel mishap may occur, and knowing you have access to travel assistance anytime of the day or night can be a huge relieve when traveling alone.

mainEntity.name: Which Travel Guard insurance plan is best for my solo trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: No matter the type of trip you’re planning, our Preferred Plan is a great place for any traveler to start. It includes popular coverages such as medical expense coverage, trip delay and baggage coverage. If you’re traveling far or for an extended period of time, you may want to consider our Deluxe Plan as an option as it has higher benefit limits and additional coverages for your trip, such as Flight Guard and Security Evacuation.

mainEntity.name: Will my travel insurance plan cover my solo trip to multiple countries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, your Travel Guard travel insurance plan will cover you for multiple destinations in a single trip.

mainEntity.name: What are travel insurance plan options as a senior traveling solo?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re a senior and looking to purchase a travel insurance plan for your solo travels, the Deluxe Plan may be the best fit. With higher benefit limits you can be sure you have the resources you need while traveling. Most importantly, make sure you purchase your travel insurance plan early. Purchasing your travel insurance plan the same day you make your first trip deposit (or soon after) may qualify you for the pre-existing medical condition exclusion waiver. With the waiver it’s possible to be covered for some medical issues on your trip, despite your pre-existing medical condition.
